---
title: "Tools"
---

A list of the tools I use for my research and writing.

## Data & Analysis

+ [R](https://www.r-project.org/) - Statistical computing and econometrics.
+ [Stata](https://www.stata.com/) - Applied econometrics.
+ [QGIS](https://qgis.org/) - Geographic data and historical maps | Here you can find a course for beginning with QGIS: [QGIS for Beginners](qgis-course/index.qmd)

## Writing

+ [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) - Papers, slides and this website.
+ [LaTeX](https://www.latex-project.org/) - Typesetting.
+ [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) - Reference management.
